name: 🎲Character RNG
desc:
A unique RNG game revolving around rolling iconic characters (that you can wear) 🎲 

🍀Premium players get a permanent +20 Luck Boost, and a 10% faster roll speed! 
🏆Like the game, join the group, and turn on notifications for a +10 Luck Boost! 
(🍀Boosts stack with everything else!) 

📜There are currently 127 characters to roll in the game!
⚙️ If your game is lagging, disable the auras in the settings!

If you encounter any bugs, please let us know on the group wall or server🐛 
⚠️The game is currently in BETA. Chances, roll values, and character titles are still up to change.⚠️

Inspired by Sol's RNG
Current Version: 7.05 (You can check your version in the settings menu)
